card.name: Harmful or illicit acts in web text
card.fires_on: Words in general web text that describe exploitation, crime or violence, such as suck up, stolen goods, rape, exterminate, slavery, and the words just before them. Mostly outside drug-label text.

modes.label: Exploitation and crime words
modes.description: Words naming predatory or criminal acts or victims, often in political or news commentary.
modes.example: began buying stolen<< goods>>, including morphine Syrettes,

modes.label: Linking words before a harmful act
modes.description: Small words or word starts that come right before a violent or abusive verb or noun.
modes.example: shooting my daughter in the head<< and>> raping her in the back of a truck

modes.label: Circumvention and takeover
modes.description: Words about draining, evading or infiltrating, such as suck up or get around.
modes.example: Those on the top suck<< up>> the wealth and gorge on a spending spree

card.plain: It lights up on web text about crime, abuse or exploitation, mostly at words leading into the harmful act.
